title: A HIT RAIDER JUMPS BACK A LITTLE FARTHER
why: His Q5: enemy feel. The raider is the commonest body in a raid and a hit pushed it only 5 px for 0.16 s. It now jumps back 6.5 px at the full flash, easing to 0 over the same 0.16 s. The Crawler keeps 8 px, every other body 5.
now: A raider you hit now jumps back a little farther.

edits.replacement: var HIT_JOLT={crawler:8,raider:6.5};   // v28.xx (cw-joltraider), his Q5 enemy feel: the raider, the commonest body, 5 to 6.5 px at the full 0.16 s flash
